about: Which corner-to-corner connector lines join the magnifier's source outline to its inset (matplotlib's indicate_inset_zoom choice). Rects are y-UP fractions of the main plot frame, [x0, y0, x1, y1]; corners are ll/ul/lr/ur. Both legs read this table: frontend/src/lib/inset.test.ts (the screen's InsetPlot) and tests/test_calc_figure_inset.py (calc.figure_inset).

cases.name: inset right, taller than the source
inset above, wider than the source
